summary: Frontend-only regression verification for Fase 68 CSS fix — status pill colors restored. Independently confirmed on /leads that all lead stage pills have expected computed backgroundColor (appointment=amber-50 rgb(255,251,235), booking=indigo-50 rgb(238,242,255), acquisition=sky-50 rgb(240,249,255), nurturing=violet-50 rgb(245,243,255), lost=rose-50 rgb(255,241,242)). Score pills verified: hot=rose-50, warm=amber-50. Dot pseudo-element (::before) is rendered on every pill (width 6px, bg-current). Swept /finance?tab=ar (paid emerald, unpaid amber, partial sky), /petty-cash (settled emerald, disbursed indigo), /subcon (active emerald), /tasks (open/medium sky), /appointments (scheduled sky). All colored — none flat gray or transparent rgba(0,0,0,0). Notifications page loaded normally; PERLU TINDAKAN badge visible (amber, per screenshot). Zero console errors across all swept pages. 93 elements with box-shadow on /leads (cards still shadowed). No visual regression detected.
critical_code_review_comments: index.css: '.status-*' block correctly placed outside @layer components (lines 210-320) with explanatory comment — good defensive documentation preventing future regressions. Consider extending pattern (or adding tailwind safelist for status-* classes in tailwind.config.js) as a belt-and-suspenders measure so purge cannot ever remove them even if someone moves the block back into @layer.
